top_signals.title: LG Deal Advances Arkansas Lithium Project
top_signals.summary: Standard Lithium CEO David Park joins Bloomberg Open Interest on the company's new deal with LG Energy Solutions and how it could unlock financing for a major US lithium project. He also warns China’s dominance of lithium chemicals poses a strategic threat and says booming demand from AI data centers, energy storage, EVs and defense could reshape the domestic lithium market. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Dollar Set to Weaken for a Second Month on Treasury Buyback
top_signals.summary: The dollar is on pace to fall for a second straight month as US plans to accelerate buyback of government debt weighed on the greenback.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: The missing piece in Trump’s oil and gas boom: jobs
top_signals.summary: Production and profits are rising strongly but industry employment has fallen since Trump came to power
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Strive becomes fifth-largest public bitcoin treasury after 1,800 BTC buy, TD Cowen lifts ASST price target
top_signals.summary: TD Cowen expects Strive (ASST) to end 2026 with 27,156 BTC, nearly 4,300 more bitcoin than previously forecast.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
